Preclinical samples state 150 days post inoculation despite age 100 and inoculation at 50 days.

Treatment and disease stage are unbalanced: clinical has 7 controls, 5 inoculated.
Age and disease stage are perfectly confounded: 100 days preclinical, 200 days clinical.
Sex and life stage are not stated; 'clinical/preclinical' is a study-specific disease stage.
